# Boise Remodeling Co

> Design-build remodeling for kitchens, bathrooms, whole-home renovations, room additions, and ADUs in Boise, Idaho and the Treasure Valley. Founded 2017. Serving Boise, Meridian, Eagle, Nampa, Kuna, Star, Middleton, and Caldwell. Phone (208) 477-1169.

## 2026 planning ranges (details on each service page)

- Kitchen remodel: $35k-$75k mid-range; $75k-$150k+ full gut with layout changes
- Bathroom remodel: $18k-$45k guest bath; $35k-$85k+ primary bath
- Whole-home remodel: $150k-$400k+
- Room addition: $80k-$250k+
- ADU: $90k-$180k garage conversion; $180k-$300k+ detached new build
